subject.statement: Do Kwon is currently in custody in Montenegro.

summary: Do Kwon was arrested in Montenegro in March 2023 and was extradited to South Korea in early 2024 after Montenegro's courts approved the extradition request. As of October 2026, he is no longer held in Montenegro.
